scenes.name: THE QUESTION
lines: Start with five, ten, five: row two of a number triangle introduced by Clark Kimberling.
从 Clark Kimberling 数三角形的第二行开始：五、十、五。
Multiply the row by its reverse and add. Twenty-five plus one hundred plus twenty-five is one hundred and fifty.
把这一行与倒序逐项相乘再相加：二十五加一百加二十五，得到一百五十。
As the rows grow, can one formula replace all these products?
当数行越来越长，一个公式能否代替所有这些乘积？

scenes.name: SYMMETRY
lines: Use powers of x to remember positions. In the square, positions adding to n supply the coefficient of x to the n.
用 x 的幂记住位置；平方时，位置之和为 n 的项贡献第 n 次幂的系数。
Every row reads the same backward. So each paired product is a square.
每一行倒过来仍相同，所以每个配对乘积都成了平方。
This exact symmetry turns the self-convolution into a sum of squares, for every row.
这个精确的对称性，把每一行的自卷积变成平方和。

scenes.name: FIVE SUMS
lines: A row entry is twice A, plus B, minus four. A and B are binomial coefficients, counting choices of objects.
每个行元素等于二倍 A 加 B 再减四；A 与 B 是计数选择方法的二项式数。
Expand its square. Five kinds of sums remain, plus a constant contribution.
展开平方后，除了常数贡献，只剩下五类和。
Choosing from two groups counts the same subsets as choosing from their union. This identity evaluates the squared and mixed sums.
从两组中选择与从它们的并集中选择，计数的是同样的子集；这个恒等式算出平方和与混合和。
For row two, these five sums are sixty-eight, twenty, six, fourteen, and four.
对第二行，这五个和依次是六十八、二十、六、十四、四。

scenes.name: THE CLOSED FORM
lines: Let c sub m count the ways to choose m objects from twice m objects. These are central binomial coefficients.
用 c 下标 m 表示从二倍 m 个对象中选出 m 个的方法数，这就是中心二项式数。
The answer uses three neighboring central binomial coefficients, a power of two, and a linear correction.
答案由三个相邻的中心二项式数、一个二的幂和一个一次修正项组成。
Ma and Zhang prove this closed form for every nonnegative row number, including the added value at zero.
Ma 与 Zhang 证明这个闭式适用于所有非负行号，包括补入的零号值。

scenes.name: WHY A RECURRENCE?
lines: Consecutive central binomial coefficients have a simple ratio, obtained by canceling factorials.
相邻中心二项式数有一个简单比值，可由阶乘约分得到。
Their three-term combination obeys a second-order relation. Call that operation B.
这三个相邻数的组合满足一个二阶关系，把这套运算记作 B。
After B, two shifted differences remove the exponential part. A final difference leaves a known linear remainder.
做 B 之后，两次移位差分消去指数部分；最后一次差分留下已知的一次余项。
A shift must move the coefficients too. This gives Mathar’s recurrence, with six sequence terms, for every n at least six.
移位也必须移动系数，由此得到对所有 n 至少为六成立、含六个序列项的 Mathar 递推式。

scenes.name: ONE STRUCTURE, MORE SEQUENCES
lines: The same central binomial relation proves recurrences for middle entries and a near-middle entry. Half-row sums also need an even-odd split.
同一个中心二项式关系还证明中间项与近中间项的递推；半行和则还需要区分奇偶。
Krause supplied the companion closed forms. The paper credits Mathar’s parity formulas and Stephan’s row-sum formula.
伴随闭式来自 Krause；论文保留 Mathar 奇偶公式和 Stephan 行和公式的归属。
The public Lean theorem checks the main recurrence for n at least six. The full closed form and companion results are explained by the manuscript proofs.
公开 Lean 定理核对了 n 至少为六的主递推；完整闭式与伴随结果由原文书面证明说明。
